title: Backend Developer Java – Payments (f/m/d)
description:
You will build and run the services behind our card processing platform.

What you'll do
- Develop and maintain Java microservices with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL
- Take part in daily Scrum, sprint planning and code reviews
- Work closely with the Product Owner on estimates and technical trade-offs
- Track tasks in Jira and document designs in Confluence

What you bring
- 3+ years of Java development
- Experience with REST APIs, Kafka and Docker
- Interest in payments and regulated environments
- Good English
